skill.descEnRank5:
Basic Attack
Deal Spectro DMG equal to 200.00% of the active Resonator's ATK.
 
Core Skill
Shorekeeper Cube generates a Stellarealm that removes the negative effects inflicted upon all Resonators within the range. All Cubes within the Stellarealm have their HP restored by 5% of the caster's Max HP per second, and their Crit. DMG increased by 50%. This effect lasts for 8s. Skill Cooldown: 20s
 
Enhanced Effect
Skill Duration Level 2/4/6/8: Stellarealm duration is increased by 2/4/6/8s.
